description:
Activate Dominion Saboteur by sacrificing it.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy Aerie Ouphes, and then also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Dominion Saboteur
uses.cardState: as a copy of Aerie Ouphes and without a -1/-1 counter on it
